g.text: Protocol A.1 separates genuine failures from non-evaluable targets

g.text: At strict Bader contracts, most apparent codec failures are not genuine compressor failures;
they occur on material-threshold pairs that are non-evaluable under the independent Protocol A.1 stability qualification.
Eligibility also invalidates apparent passes: 106/229 (46.3%) at 10^-4 e.
